en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Ibrahim Bin Umar Al Yamani, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Ourasws Shia are the people of guidance, and the people of piety, and the people of goodness, and the people of Emān, and people of victory and triumph’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Ibrahim ibn ‘Umar al-Yamani from a man from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Our Shi’a (followers) are people of guidance, of piety, of goodness, of belief and people of victory and triumph.”
